observed_value: FX01 source artifact rows report blank principal_amount_usd for rows classified as non-USD source par.
anchor_value: Raw SOI table shows dollar-denominated Outstanding Principal presentation; targeted EUR, GBP, and CAD source searches returned no hits.

culprit_citations.quoted_text: Investments (1)(2) | Footnotes | Reference Rate Spread / Floor | PIK Rate | Maturity Date | Outstanding Principal | Cost* | Fair Value | Percentage of Net Assets

rationale: FX01 asserts non-USD source par needs an explicit USD principal conversion, but the raw source checked does not show non-USD par. Table 27 presents Outstanding Principal in an accounting dollar column: row 7 includes the dollar marker and row 8 continues the same dollar-denominated presentation with the symbol omitted, a normal table carry-forward pattern. Targeted source searches for EUR, GBP, and CAD across the filing returned zero hits. The flag is therefore reacting to blank repeated currency-symbol cells or row-scope presentation rather than an actual non-USD principal conversion defect.
